label: Week 7 brief

storylines.title: Two quarterbacks, two plans
storylines.fact: Lamar Jackson is questionable with a high ankle sprain. He practised on a limited basis all week. "I can't call it right now," he said Friday [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50260001/ravens-lamar-jackson-high-ankle-sprain-unsure-play). Baltimore is 11–2 against Cincinnati with him and 0–3 without him [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50241195/lamar-jackson-practice-unclear-vs-bengals-week-7).
storylines.why: **Why it matters:** the bye-week plan was to contain Jackson. If Tyler Huntley starts, the plan flips: crowd the line against Derrick Henry and make Huntley throw. He averages 6.0 yards a pass to Jackson's 10.1 [Bengals.com](https://www.bengals.com/news/bengals-ravens-preview-scouting-report-week-7-2026).

storylines.title: Hendrickson against his old team
storylines.fact: Trey Hendrickson's 30% pass rush win rate is third in the NFL [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50250751/ravens-hendrickson-facing-bengals-not-me). He lines up across from Orlando Brown Jr., who has allowed two sacks in five games. Baltimore is 4–2 against Burrow when it sacks him three or more times [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50229521/week-7-picks-predictions-schedule-fantasy-odds-2026).
storylines.why: **Non-obvious:** the answer is not Brown winning every snap. Burrow's release is the third fastest in the league at 2.57 seconds [stats page](https://petedilworth.github.io/bengals-fanzone/stats.html). Quick throws take Hendrickson out of the game.

storylines.title: Baltimore's line cannot stay on schedule
storylines.fact: The Ravens offence has an NFL-worst 31 flags: 13 false starts and 13 holds, plus three delays of game at Cleveland [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50218886/nfl-power-rankings-week-7-teams-biggest-issue-offense). Cincinnati pressures 40% of dropbacks while blitzing only 18% of the time [Bengals.com](https://www.bengals.com/news/bengals-stats-bye-week-2026-joe-burrow-dexter-lawrence-ii-boye-mafe).
storylines.why: **Non-obvious:** centre Cam Jurgens is cleared from his concussion and practised fully [Bengals.com](https://www.bengals.com/news/bengals-ravens-week-7-2026-injury-report). ESPN argues his return may hurt: his stand-in blocked better in pass protection [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50229521/week-7-picks-predictions-schedule-fantasy-odds-2026).

storylines.title: Whoever leads by 10 may still lose
storylines.fact: Baltimore has blown 16 double-digit leads since 2020, the most in the NFL. In those fourth quarters, passers threw 17 touchdowns and no interceptions [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50219611/ravens-nfl-worst-blowing-double-digit-leads). Cincinnati let winless Miami back from 28–10 two weeks ago [Local 12](https://local12.com/sports/bengals/bengals-bye-week-zac-taylor-injuries-late-game-issues-ravens).
storylines.why: **Why it matters:** neither team closes. A fast start proves nothing here. The last 10 minutes decide it.

storylines.title: Run at the middle of the dime
storylines.fact: Cincinnati's busiest run gap is the middle: 41 carries, 41% success, exactly league average. Baltimore allows 45% success there on 22 carries, its weakest inside gap [stats page](https://petedilworth.github.io/bengals-fanzone/stats.html). It also plays a six-defensive-back dime on 32% of snaps, second most [Bengals.com](https://www.bengals.com/news/bengals-ravens-preview-scouting-report-week-7-2026).
storylines.why: **Why it matters:** dime means fewer big bodies in the box. The run the Bengals use most is the one Baltimore stops worst. Small sample: 22 carries.

watch.title: Jackson on the inactive list
watch.text: His decision may wait until inactives come out [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/player/_/id/3916387/lamar-jackson). It decides which defensive plan Cincinnati uses. Also check left tackle Ronnie Stanley: he missed Friday's practice but has no game status [Bengals.com](https://www.bengals.com/news/bengals-ravens-week-7-2026-injury-report).
watch.after: Jackson did not play. Tyler Huntley threw all 38 Ravens passes [nflverse](https://github.com/nflverse/nflverse-data/releases/tag/pbp), so the plan built for Huntley was the one that ran.

watch.title: Ravens flags on early downs
watch.text: Count false starts and delays. Each one turns a Henry run into a passing down, which is where Cincinnati's four-man rush wins.
watch.after: Baltimore had five pre-snap penalties [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50281972/after-loss-jesse-minter-says-ravens-need-identity-check) and 10 accepted penalties in all, to Cincinnati's one [Bengals.com](https://www.bengals.com/news/bengals-keep-their-cool-ravens-joe-burrow-jamarr-chase-zac-taylor).

watch.title: Where the Bengals run
watch.text: Watch if carries go up the middle or to the edges. The numbers point inside. A lean on outside runs means the staff sees something the numbers do not.
watch.after: Only 19 designed runs, 14 of them after half. Up the middle, 4 of 5 succeeded, the best of any gap [nflverse](https://github.com/nflverse/nflverse-data/releases/tag/pbp). Too few carries to prove the map.

watch.title: Hendrickson on Brown, and the clock in Burrow's head
watch.text: Three sacks is Baltimore's winning number. Watch for chips from a tight end or back on Brown's side, and how fast Burrow lets it go.
watch.after: Brown allowed two pressures on 34 dropbacks against Hendrickson [Bengals.com](https://www.bengals.com/news/bengals-keep-their-cool-ravens-joe-burrow-jamarr-chase-zac-taylor). Burrow was sacked once, not by Hendrickson [nflverse](https://github.com/nflverse/nflverse-data/releases/tag/pbp).

watch.title: Who protects a lead
watch.text: If either team leads by 10, watch the other quarterback's passing. Both teams have given up late leads this year.
watch.after: Nobody protected a lead. Baltimore's 13–0 became 14–13 by the end of the third quarter and 35–13 at the end [nflverse](https://github.com/nflverse/nflverse-data/releases/tag/pbp).

lineFinding: Burrow is good against four rushers and poor against more. With four, the offence gains 0.21 expected points a dropback on 144 plays. With five or more, it loses 0.11 on 53 plays [stats page](https://petedilworth.github.io/bengals-fanzone/stats.html). After Week 6, Baltimore's pass rush win rate rose to 10th, from 19th a week earlier [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/49742016/2026-win-rates-team-player-rankings-pass-rush-run-stop-blocking). A four-man rush that wins has no reason to blitz, and four is the look Burrow handles best. No outlet has raised this split in three weeks.
devilsAdvocate: **The pass rush may be weaker than it looks.** Cincinnati pressures 40% of dropbacks, but ESPN ranks its pass rush win rate 23rd [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/49742016/2026-win-rates-team-player-rankings-pass-rush-run-stop-blocking). Both cannot describe Sunday. If the win rate is right, Baltimore's line holds.

**The run numbers are thin.** The middle-gap edge rests on 22 Baltimore carries and a Bengals run game ranked 15th [stats page](https://petedilworth.github.io/bengals-fanzone/stats.html). One stuffed drive and the staff will throw.

**Jackson on one leg is still Jackson.** He averages 10.1 yards a pass, best in the league, and he does it from the pocket [Bengals.com](https://www.bengals.com/news/bengals-ravens-preview-scouting-report-week-7-2026). A plan built for a hobbled runner may face a sharp passer.

alternativeView.title: The same game, from Baltimore
alternativeView.text: Baltimore sees a home game against a team that has lost six of its last eight to the Ravens [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50229521/week-7-picks-predictions-schedule-fantasy-odds-2026). Its plan writes itself: run Henry, put Hendrickson on Brown and wait for Cincinnati's late mistakes. The worry is its own line. If the flags keep coming, even a healthy Jackson spends the day on third-and-long.

meaning: Storyline 4 came true, on Baltimore's side. The Ravens led 13–0 at half and lost by 22. Only two teams had ever lost by 20 or more after leading by 13 or more at half: the 1941 Eagles and the 1950 Colts [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50281972/after-loss-jesse-minter-says-ravens-need-identity-check). Burrow went 6 of 12 for 43 yards before half, then 16 of 18 for 249 and four touchdowns after [Bengals.com](https://www.bengals.com/news/postgame-quick-hits-ja-marr-chase-second-half-stats-ravens-week-7-2026). Baltimore converted 9 of 16 third downs [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/boxscore/_/gameId/401873012), all but one of them before half [nflverse](https://github.com/nflverse/nflverse-data/releases/tag/pbp). The brief was right about Baltimore's flags and about Brown holding up. It expected Baltimore to win with four rushers. Instead the Ravens blitzed on 11 of 32 dropbacks, and Burrow beat it after half [stats page](https://petedilworth.github.io/bengals-fanzone/stats.html). It never saw the first half coming: 19 Bengals plays before the break [Bengals.com](https://www.bengals.com/news/postgame-quick-hits-ja-marr-chase-second-half-stats-ravens-week-7-2026).
